query:
UPDATE webhook_logs 
            SET 
                status = $2,
                http_status_code = $3,
                error_message = $4,
                last_attempt = NOW(),
                attempt_count = attempt_count + 1,
                latency_ms = $5,
                delivered_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'delivered' THEN NOW() ELSE delivered_at END
            WHERE id = $1
